payload.top_notice: The end-to-end low-rank ribbon scan run now has a hash-bound terminal result candidate: it is terminal-blocked before formal scan planning because six non-pointed rows still lack content-addressed ribbon realization snapshots and required coherence/ribbon certificates. This note is a checkpoint and review notice only; it does not admit final classification or scan claims.
validated_behaviors: The completion run records the v10 partial catalog, blocked step 6 scan-plan generation attempt, blocked step 7 control attempt, blocked step 8 target scan attempt, and blocked step 9 aggregate attempt by hash.
All six remaining non-pointed rows have terminal-blocked row records with required evidence and missing evidence listed.
The terminal blocker candidate explicitly stops before scan planning and does not claim scan completion.
The review package records final_claims_admitted=false and proposes only a terminal blocker claim for later user review.
